name: AEGIS-DocIntel AI Quality & Retrieval Benchmark
description: Standardized evaluation suite for document extraction fidelity, context packing invariants, PII redaction precision/recall, and evidence-grounded retrieval.

extraction.description: Multipage, multi-column reading order and structured table reconstruction evaluation

packing.description: Submodular context packing budget constraints, greedy approximation bounds, and diversity

privacy.description: Synthetic PII redaction precision, recall, and zero downstream secret leakage

retrieval.description: Evidence retrieval accuracy, citation integrity, and unanswerable query abstention
